links.comparator_used: Manual review/abstraction of ophthalmic diagnostic PDF reports (reconciled manual ground truth and manual extraction time)
links.outcome: Extraction time and accuracy of structured data extraction from PDF reports
links.effect: Mean extraction time 56.51 s per report for manual review vs 5.04 s Schema-Constrained and 4.70 s Prompt-Only (~92% reduction); value accuracy 97.45-100% (Schema-Constrained) and 100% (Prompt-Only) vs manual ground truth
links.tradeoff: Small proof-of-concept (20 reports); Schema-Constrained value accuracy fell to 97.45% for Glaucoma Overview and 98.00% for Thickness Map; Prompt-Only formatting accuracy fell to 90.14% for RNFL Single Exam.
links.quote: Mean extraction time was 56.51 s per report for manual review versus 5.04 s for Schema-Constrained and 4.70 s for Prompt-Only, an approximately 92% reduction.

links.comparator_used: Prompt-Only: detailed instruction prompt followed by Python conversion to JSON, without a predefined JSON Schema in Structured Output mode
links.outcome: Value accuracy and formatting accuracy of extracted data
links.effect: Schema-Constrained value accuracy 100% (Visual Field, RNFL Single Exam), 97.45% (Glaucoma Overview), 98.00% (Thickness Map) vs Prompt-Only 100% across all; formatting accuracy 100% for Schema-Constrained across all types vs Prompt-Only 100% except RNFL Single Exam (90.14%). Extraction time 5.04 s vs 4.70 s.
links.tradeoff: Schema-Constrained had slightly lower value accuracy on two report types; Prompt-Only had a formatting failure on RNFL Single Exam and required a Python conversion step.
links.quote: Prompt-Only achieved the highest value accuracy, while Schema-Constrained produced schema-compliant output with 100% formatting accuracy.

design_hint: schema-constrained structured output vs prompt-only extraction
